items.title: Capping with a Chern class is well defined on rational equivalence classes of cycles
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that capping a cycle with a Chern class of a finite locally free sheaf depends only on the rational equivalence class of the cycle, so that these caps are well defined operations on Chow groups (statement lines 7363-7371). The proof transfers the question to the projective bundle, where the capped classes are uniquely determined by a single equation, and uses that flat pullback respects rational equivalence so that both sides satisfy the same equation. The transfer and the appeal to uniqueness are the substance, so the claim is H2.
